items.title: How Amazon CloudFront secures and accelerates the AWS MCP Server
items.summary: The AWS MCP Server, a managed remote server for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), runs in production behind Amazon CloudFront. Hundreds of thousands of AWS accounts call it, and it handles millions of tool calls every month. Every request enters one of CloudFront’s more than 750 Points of Presence (PoPs), the edge locations nearest the […]
